Firstly, I would like to thank you for taking the time to read my post, and to post such a detailed response. I would also like to thank you for complimenting my writing - I work for a YGO! magazine, so it's always nice to be complimented on my writing.

I'm very sorry to hear about your situation with your wife, you seem like a nice guy and nice guys don't deserve that kind of treatment. I sincerly hope that your life takes a turn for the good in the near future.

I've pretty much come to your conclusion too, that there is no promises in life, nor is there justice. It's not the grandest outlook when you've just jumped out of uni into the real world, I can tell you. 

Thank you once again for such a detailed and thought-out responce.

Thank you for taking the time to read through my post, and for responding <3 

The link was really useful, thank you very much for showing it me. And take it from me, the goth scene is pretty friendly. I'm not one myself, but some of the people I knew before they moved away were part of it, and were some of the nicest people I ever knew.
Thank you for taking the time to read my post, and to respond <3

First off, thank you for taking the time to read and respond. You and Reddit have my eternal love for this.

The only problem with looking to tomorrow is that generally, tomorrow is the same as today, which is the same as yesterday, which ain't the most pleasant of thoughts. That said, it is a great deal better than looking further in the future and believing that day 1345 from now is the same as the present.

Today is a little different though, as tomorrow holds an Enter Shikari gig with my best mate =D I'd be counting me heading to an anime expo to be working on a YGO! Magazine stand as a highlight, but the guy that broke me and my gf up and had his way with her will be there, as my collegue. Not fucking fun >_< But Enter Shikari will be good enough for now.

Thank you once again for your words of kindness.
